products.title: Belted Wrap Knit Vest
keywords: cute clothes for women in their 30s
products.short: A soft knit wrap vest with a wide shawl collar and a self-tie belt, cut to layer over everything you already own. Chest 40–46 inches, length 25 inches.
products.description:
A sleeveless knit cut like a wrap jacket: a wide shawl collar, no buttons anywhere, and a self-tie belt you pull as tight as you want it. Tied, it has a waist. Left open, it hangs long and straight over whatever is underneath, which is two quite different garments from one hanger.

It is the third piece — the thing you put on over a tee and jeans that turns them into an outfit you would answer the door in. Most third pieces are either a blazer that needs a shirt under it or a cardigan that reads as a dressing gown. This one sits between the two, which is a harder line to walk than it sounds and the reason it keeps selling out.

The fabric

A soft mid-weight knit that drapes rather than holds — closer in hand to a cardigan than to tailoring, and deliberately so. There is enough body in the yarn for the shawl collar to roll properly instead of lying flat, and enough give that it does not pull across the back when you reach for something. It is warm without being bulky, which is the only way a layer this long works indoors as well as out.

How it fits

Chest 40–46 inches, length 25 inches, in one size that genuinely covers that span because of the belt. The length falls to the top of the thigh on most people and a little lower if you are petite, which is a flattering place for a hem to land. Nothing about it is cut close, so what you wear underneath decides the shape far more than the vest does. If you are between sizes anywhere else in the shop, this is the piece that will not care.

Looking after it

Cold hand wash or a wool cycle, reshaped flat to dry. Knits of this weight will stretch on a hanger over a season, so fold it. The belt washes with it; pull it out of the loops first so the ties do not twist.

Korean fashion winter dressing runs on pieces like this, and it is one of the few cute clothes for women in their 30s that does not have to be either sharp or slouchy. If you are building korean style winter wear out of a small number of things, start here: it is the rare piece of korean fashion for women that works as comfy cute clothes at home and as a third piece in an office.

products.title: Kkongju Skin ACXII Acne & Brightening Soap
products.short: A cleansing bar with salicylic acid, made for breakout-prone skin and uneven tone. The simplest change most routines can make.
products.description:
A salicylic acid soap in bar form. Salicylic acid is oil-soluble, which means it works inside the pore rather than sitting on top of it, and that is why it turns up in almost everything aimed at breakouts.

Half the people who ask us about their skin have a drawer of half-used serums and no cleanser worth the name. A bar with an active in it is the cheapest change to make and the easiest one to keep up, because it lives at the sink and asks nothing of you beyond the twenty seconds you were going to spend anyway.

What is in it

Salicylic acid for the pores, with brightening ingredients worked through the bar for tone. It lathers properly and rinses clean rather than leaving the film a conditioning bar leaves behind. Kkongju Skin make three of these, each aimed at a different thing; this is the one for active breakouts.

The size of it

One bar. Used once a day it lasts most people a couple of months, which makes it the least expensive active in the shop by some distance.

Good to know

Keep it on a draining dish rather than in a pool of water; any soap left sitting wet will go soft and disappear at twice the rate. Not for use around the eyes, and if your skin is already peeling from something else, give it a week off.

It is the most-repurchased korean cleansing bar on our shelf, and the one customers come back for by name rather than by description — which for korean skincare is the only recommendation worth much.

products.title: AHC Premier Ampoule In Eye Cream 40ml
products.short: A collagen eye cream with a concentrated ampoule suspended inside it, aimed at the look of fine lines. 40ml, which is a large tube for an eye cream.
products.description:
An ampoule suspended inside an eye cream. The ampoule is the concentrated part; the cream is what carries it, keeps it stable and slows it down enough to be absorbed by skin that is thinner there than anywhere else on your face.

Most eye creams come in a pot the size of a thimble and run out before you have any idea whether they work. This is a 40ml tube, which is enough to use twice a day for months — and months is the only timescale on which anything at all can be judged.

What is in it

T4 collagen is the active, aimed at the appearance of fine lines, with enough hydration behind it that the skin under the eye stops looking crepey by mid-afternoon. The texture is a light cream rather than a balm, so it sits under concealer without moving it.

The size of it

40ml. Large enough that most people stop rationing it and start using it on the whole face, which is not a mistake — nothing in it is for eyes alone beyond the gentleness.

Good to know

Keep the cap on and the tube out of a sunlit window. If your eyes are sensitive, patch it on the inner wrist for a night first. Nothing in it conflicts with a retinol used elsewhere on the face, but do not layer the two on the same patch of skin.

AHC is one of the better-known houses in korean skincare and this is the product it is known for. It is the korean eye cream we sell most of, and a collagen eye cream is the sensible place to start if you have never used one.

products.title: ANJO Professional 365 Sun Cream SPF50+ PA+++ 70g
products.short: A light, non-greasy SPF50+ PA+++ sun cream with sodium hyaluronate and shea butter. The plain, untinted one. 70g.
products.description:
Broad-spectrum SPF50+ PA+++ in a texture light enough to wear under makeup every day — which is the only test a daily sunscreen has to pass. Everything else about a sunscreen is beside the point if it sits badly enough that you skip it on Thursday.

This is the plain version: no tint, no tone-up, nothing to blend. If you want protection and nothing else, it is the one to buy, and the 70g tube is large enough that you will apply the amount you are supposed to rather than rationing it.

What is in it

Sodium hyaluronate and shea butter keep it from drying the skin out over a day, and tocopheryl is in there as the antioxidant. No heavy finish, no white cast, nothing to rub in for a minute before it disappears.

The size of it

70g, which is the big tube. At the quantity a face actually needs — about two fingers' length — it still lasts a couple of months of daily use.

Good to know

Keep it out of a hot car; heat degrades UV filters faster than time does. Once opened, use it within a year — and at this size, you will.

It is the untinted twin of the ANJO BB cream, and the korean sun cream for anyone who wants an spf 50 sunscreen and no opinions about their complexion. If you are starting a korean skincare routine from nothing, start with this step.

products.title: ANJO Professional 365 Sun BB Cream SPF50+ PA+++
products.short: A tinted SPF50+ PA+++ sun cream that doubles as a makeup base, with hyaluronic acid, shea butter and green tea extract.
products.description:
A korean sun cream and a base in one tube: SPF50+ PA+++ against UVA and UVB, with a tint light enough to wear on its own or under foundation.

Two steps collapse into one, which is the whole argument. It is the difference between wearing sunscreen every day and wearing it when you remember, because a tinted sunscreen is a thing you put on to look like yourself rather than a chore you do first.

What is in it

Hyaluronic acid, shea butter and green tea extract are in the formula to hydrate and soften. That is why it works as a primer rather than sliding under whatever goes on top — a drier sunscreen is the usual reason a base breaks up by lunchtime.

The size of it

One shade, pitched at the middle of the range and sheer enough to adjust itself on most skin. If you wear a foundation darker than medium, treat it as a base rather than as coverage.

Good to know

Shake it before the first use of the day; the tint settles. Keep it off a radiator or a sunny sill, and finish it within a year of opening.

A sun bb cream is the shortcut for anyone who has given up on a separate SPF and a separate base. This is the one people repurchase, and the easiest korean skincare habit to start.

products.title: Artisan Ribbed Knit Midi Dress
products.short: A heavy ribbed knit midi with a detachable knit vest over it, so one hanger gives you two ways to leave the house. Beige, brown or black.
products.description:
The dress underneath is a plain long-sleeved midi in a heavy ribbed knit. The rib runs vertically, which is the whole reason it hangs the way it does: it falls from the shoulder without clinging anywhere on the way down, and it lengthens the line while it is at it.

The knit vest over the top comes off. Worn together they read as one piece and the texture does the talking; worn apart you have a dress for the office and a vest for everything else. We have had customers buy it for the vest alone, which is not the worst way to think about the price.

The fabric

A heavy-gauge ribbed knit with real recovery in it — it goes back to its shape after a day of sitting rather than keeping the shape of the chair. The vest is knitted from the same yarn, so the two never look like an accident when they are worn together. Neither piece is lined; both are opaque.

How it fits

Sized S–M, with enough give that the span it covers is wider than the label suggests. The waist is elastic rather than seamed, so it sits where your waist actually is rather than where a pattern cutter guessed. The hem falls mid-calf on most people. As a petite dress long sleeve shape it works without alteration — the sleeve ends at the wrist on a shorter frame rather than past it, which is the alteration most knit dresses need.

Looking after it

Cold hand wash or a wool cycle, dried flat. Both pieces will stretch on a hanger, so fold them. A knit this heavy takes a day to dry properly; do not rush it on a radiator or the rib will set hard.

It is the Korean fashion casual dress people reach for when they want to look considered and have eleven minutes, and among cute clothes for winter it is the one that does the work of two garments. If you have been shopping dress korean fashion and finding everything either too short or too fussy, this is the shape to try.

products.title: Asymmetrical Tartan Pleated Midi Skirt
products.short: A violet, oat and honey tartan midi with an accordion-pleated panel down one side. Length 27.5 inches, in two waist sizes.
products.description:
Tartan in deep violet, creamy oat and a golden honey, cut as a straight A-line — except down one side, where an accordion-pleated panel takes over. The asymmetry is the reason to own it rather than any of the other plaid skirts on any other rail.

Standing still it reads as a good heritage skirt and nothing more. Walking, the pleated panel opens and closes on its own and the whole thing becomes something else. That is a lot of effect for a skirt that is, on paper, a plaid midi.

The fabric

Polyester and rayon. The polyester is what holds a pleat this sharp through a season of wearing and sitting; the rayon is what stops the hand feeling plasticky. The plaid is woven rather than printed, so the colours have depth to them close up and the pattern runs true at the seams.

How it fits

Two sizes on the waist, M (27–28") and L (29–30"). The waistband is fitted and sits at the natural waist rather than on the hip, so a top tucks in cleanly and stays tucked. Length 27.5 inches, which puts the hem below the knee on most people and at mid-calf if you are petite. There is no stretch in the waistband, so take the larger size if you are between the two.

Looking after it

Dry clean, or a cold delicate wash inside a mesh bag if you are confident, and hang it to dry by the waistband so the pleats fall straight. Never fold it across the pleats. A cool iron on the reverse if a pleat has lost its edge.

It is the Korean fashion skirt that solves the cute fall fashion problem of wanting pattern without wanting to think about it, and one of the few korean fashion for women pieces here that reads as smart enough for petite clothes for work and interesting enough for a Saturday.

products.title: Autumn Explorer Utility Jacket
products.short: A boxy tobacco-brown utility jacket with a sharp point collar, a chest flap pocket and tie-fastening cuffs. Sized L, cut relaxed.
products.description:
A warm mahogany brown, cut boxy and relaxed so a thick jumper goes under it without a fight. A jacket that fits nobody in particular fits almost everybody, which is the quiet trick of this shape and the reason it is the first thing people try on.

The collar is a sharp point — the one structured thing on an otherwise easy jacket, and what stops it reading as a shirt. The cuffs tie rather than button, so you set the sleeve volume yourself on a day when you want it sharper.

The fabric

A smooth, high-density woven fabric, crisp to the touch and enough to turn a breeze. It holds the boxy line rather than collapsing at the shoulder, and it is unlined — this is a transitional jacket rather than a winter coat, and it is honest about that.

How it fits

Sized L and cut generously, with a dropped shoulder and room through the body for a knit underneath. The hem sits at the hip. The flap pocket on the chest is in the workwear tradition and is deep enough to be useful rather than decorative.

Looking after it

Cold machine wash and hang to dry; it presses easily if you want the collar crisp. The tie cuffs will tangle in a drum, so knot them loosely before it goes in.

It is the korean fashion jacket shape that works on everyone because it is not fitted anywhere, the single most useful cute fall fashion layer we have had in, and the one piece of korean style winter wear that goes under a bigger coat without bulking the shoulder when korean fashion winter properly arrives.

products.title: Beaute Angel Queen's Cushion #21, 15g
products.short: A lightweight cushion compact in shade 21, for full coverage with a radiant finish. 15g, with the puff included.
products.description:
A cushion foundation is the Korean answer to a liquid base: the product sits in a sponge, you press it with the puff, and you build coverage in thin layers rather than one thick one. It is faster than a brush, kinder than fingers, and almost impossible to overdo.

This one covers fully and finishes radiant rather than flat, with skincare ingredients worked into the formula so it is not simply sitting on top of the day.

What is in it

A hydrating base with the coverage of a medium foundation. Shade #21 is the lighter of the two standard Korean shades and the one most people here wear; it is sheer enough at the edges to blend without a visible jaw line.

The size of it

15g in the compact, with the puff in the lid. That is six to eight weeks of daily use for most people, and the compact is small enough to live in a coat pocket rather than on a shelf.

Good to know

Close the inner lid as well as the outer one or the sponge dries out. Wash the puff weekly in warm water and a drop of cleanser, and let it dry flat. Replace the puff before you replace the compact.

A korean cushion compact is the one piece of k-beauty makeup worth carrying, because it refreshes a face in ten seconds without a mirror ritual — and with korean skincare in the formula, it is doing something while it sits there.

products.title: Beaute Glutathione Vitamin Ampoule Balm
products.short: A solid ampoule balm with glutathione and vitamins, in a twist-up compact for targeted use.
products.description:
An ampoule in balm form, in a twist-up compact. That is the point of it: an ampoule in a bottle stays on the bathroom shelf, and a glutathione balm goes in a bag and gets used on the patch that needs it.

Glutathione and vitamins are the brightening pair, and the balm format means they go exactly where you put them rather than being decanted over a whole face.

What is in it

A solid brightening balm that softens on contact with skin. Glutathione is the brightening agent; the vitamins are there to support it. No water in the formula, which is why it is stable in a compact rather than a dark glass bottle.

The size of it

One twist-up compact, small enough for a coat pocket. Used on the patches that need it rather than all over, it lasts a long time.

Good to know

Keep the lid on and the compact out of a hot bag in summer; a balm this soft will slump above about 30°C and will not re-form the same way. Wipe the surface with a tissue if it picks up makeup.

It is the most portable thing on our korean skincare shelf and the one people buy a second of for a desk drawer. A korean ampoule in a brightening balm format suits a day out rather than a bathroom shelf.

products.title: Beaute Vita Collagen Tone-Up Sunscreen SPF50+ PA+++ 45ml
products.short: An SPF50+ PA+++ tone-up sunscreen with collagen and vitamins, finishing dewy rather than sticky. 45ml.
products.description:
Broad-spectrum SPF50+ PA+++ with a tone-up effect: it brightens and evens the skin as it goes on, so it reads more like a base than a sunscreen.

Most tone-up creams are tacky enough that you wear them once and then leave them in a drawer. This one finishes dewy and sits under everything else, which is the difference between a product you own and a product you use.

What is in it

A collagen sunscreen — collagen and vitamins carry the formula, and the tone-up comes from a light diffusing pigment rather than a white cast. It hydrates enough that dry skin does not go tight under it by midday.

The size of it

45ml, which lasts longer than it sounds because a tone-up needs less than a chalky white sunscreen does. Suitable for daily use on all skin types.

Good to know

Keep it off a sunny windowsill and finish it within a year of opening. Shake it if the pigment has settled after a long gap.

It is the korean sun cream for people who want one product between a cleansed face and the door, and the tone up sunscreen we recommend first to anyone new to korean skincare.

products.title: Bonnyhill Strawberry Collagen Heartleaf Toner Pads, 60 pads
products.short: Sixty soaked toner pads with strawberry extract, collagen and heartleaf, for brightness and firmness.
products.description:
A collagen toner pad does three things at once: it tones, it exfoliates lightly as you wipe, and it leaves the essence behind on the skin. That is why pads have more or less replaced bottled toner here.

Strawberry extract brings antioxidants and vitamins for brightness; collagen is there for elasticity; heartleaf is the calming ingredient Korean houses reach for when skin is irritated. The three together make this the brightening one of the pair we stock.

What is in it

Each pad is embossed on one side and smooth on the other — the embossed side for a light sweep, the smooth side for laying on the skin. Soaked rather than damp, so there is enough essence in one pad to cover a face and still have some left to press in.

The size of it

Sixty pads in the jar. Used once a day that is two months; morning and night, one.

Good to know

Use the tongs or clean fingers rather than dipping a hand in, and close the lid firmly; a jar left open dries from the top down. Keep it out of direct sun.

The korean toner pad is the format that has replaced bottled toner for most people here, and this is the brightening toner we restock most often — the easiest korean skincare step to add to a routine that already works.

products.title: Bonnyhill Ampoule Sheet Masks
products.short: Second-skin sheet masks soaked in concentrated ampoule. Three versions: heartleaf to calm, niacinamide to brighten, rice to soften.
products.description:
A thin second-skin sheet soaked in concentrated ampoule rather than a watery essence, which is what separates an ampoule mask from the cheap ones that have dried out before the twenty minutes are up.

Three versions, each aimed at a different thing: heartleaf to calm skin that has reacted to something, niacinamide to work on tone, rice to soften and plump. The quickest way to find out whether an ingredient suits you is twenty minutes with it on your face rather than six weeks and a full-size bottle.

What is in it

The sheet is cut thin enough to sit against the skin without sliding, and holds enough serum that there is some left in the sachet when you take it off. That is worth pressing into the neck and the backs of the hands rather than throwing away.

The size of it

One sheet per sachet, sold singly so you can work through the three versions and settle on one rather than committing to a box of ten.

Good to know

Store the sachets flat and out of the sun, and use one within a few minutes of opening it. There is no benefit to leaving a sheet on past twenty minutes; after that it takes moisture back out of the skin.

A korean sheet mask is the simplest way to test an ingredient before buying a bottle of it, and this is the hydrating face mask we point people at when they ask where to start with korean skincare.

products.title: Bonnyhill Honeybee Propolis Cream 170ml
products.short: A rich propolis, royal jelly and honey cream for dry skin and a stressed barrier. 170ml, all skin types.
products.description:
A thick, nourishing korean moisturizer built on propolis, royal jelly and honey extracts. It is the one to reach for when skin is tight, flaking, or generally behaving as though it has had enough.

Every winter somebody comes in with a routine of nine products and skin that has stopped cooperating. This is the dry skin cream we hand them: heavy, uncomplicated, and nothing in it trying to be clever.

What is in it

Propolis is the resin bees seal a hive with and it has been in Korean skincare for decades for the same reason it is in a hive: it protects a surface. Royal jelly and honey extract carry the moisture. The texture is a true balm-weight cream, not a gel pretending to be one.

The size of it

170ml, which is a large pot — it will last a season of winter evenings. Suitable for all skin types, though oily skin will prefer it at night only.

Good to know

Use clean fingers or a spatula rather than dipping in after cleansing, and close the lid firmly. Keep it out of direct sun and finish it within a year of opening.

A propolis cream sits at the heavy end of a routine and this is the heaviest we stock — the korean skincare answer to a winter that has gone on too long.

products.title: Bonnyhill Heartleaf Toner Pads, 60 pads
products.short: Sixty soaked heartleaf toner pads to calm, balance and hydrate irritated skin. The plainest pad we carry.
products.description:
Heartleaf — houttuynia cordata — is the botanical Korean houses reach for when skin is angry, and a heartleaf toner is the simplest way to get it onto your face without adding a step.

No acid, no fruit extract, nothing to react to. That is the whole specification, and it is exactly what reactive skin is looking for. It is the plainest thing on our skincare shelf and the one we restock most.

What is in it

Each pad is soaked rather than damp, with enough essence in it to cover a face and leave some to press in. Embossed on one side for a light sweep, smooth on the other for laying flat on a patch.

The size of it

Sixty pads in the jar. Morning and night that is a month; once a day, two.

Good to know

Use the tongs or clean fingers rather than dipping a hand in, and press the lid down firmly - a jar left open dries from the top down. Keep it out of direct sun.

It is the sensitive skin toner we recommend first, and the korean toner pad for anyone whose skin reacts to anything with fruit acid in it — the gentlest korean skincare step there is.

products.title: Bonnyhill Rice Niacinamide Cream 100ml
products.short: A rice extract and niacinamide cream for hydration, tone and texture. 100ml.
products.description:
Rice extract and niacinamide in one pot — two actives most people were buying separately, at the price of one of them.

Rice is the antioxidant side of it and has been in Korean skincare for as long as there has been Korean skincare. Niacinamide is vitamin B3: it supports the skin barrier, calms redness, and is the ingredient most people are actually after when they buy a niacinamide cream.

What is in it

A proper cream rather than a gel in a cream's clothing. It absorbs without leaving a film, which matters if anything is going on top of it, and a rice extract cream is among the gentlest ways to work on tone.

The size of it

100ml. Used morning and night that is about three months.

Good to know

Use clean fingers or a spatula rather than dipping in after cleansing, and close the lid firmly. Keep it out of direct sun and finish it within a year of opening.

It is the korean moisturizer to pick if you want one product doing a few jobs rather than four doing one each, and a sensible place to restart a korean skincare routine that has grown longer than your morning.

products.title: Celestial Midnight A-Line Gown
products.short: An ink-black A-line gown with ivory brushstrokes across the bodice, cut long with a soft pleated sweep. Black or brown.
products.description:
Black from the shoulder down, broken across the bodice by a band of ivory brushstrokes that look painted rather than printed. It is the only pattern on the dress and it sits where a pattern does the most work.

Long dresses are usually bought for one evening and then hang in a wardrobe reproaching you. This one is knit on top and corduroy below, so it is warm enough to wear in the months you are actually invited to things.

The fabric

The top half is a thick soft knit with real stretch in it; the sleeves and the skirt are a lighter corduroy that moves when you do. The waistband is wide and elastic, which is what lets the skirt swing instead of hang. Accordion-pleated through the skirt, so it reads formal standing still and forgives you at the table.

How it fits

One size. Bust 34–46 inches, waist 30–40 inches, length 42 inches — and the range on those is not a typo, the knit genuinely covers it. At 42 inches the hem skims the ankle on a shorter frame rather than pooling, which is why it works as a petite dresses evening wear option without a hem alteration.

Looking after it

Dry clean, or a cold delicate wash inside a mesh bag if you are confident, hung by the waistband so the pleats fall straight. Never fold it across the pleats. A cool iron on the reverse if an edge has softened.

As a korean fashion formal dress it is dressy without being fussy, which is a harder line to walk than it sounds — and among petite dresses special occasion options, one of very few that needs nothing done to it first.

products.title: Embroidered Fair Isle Knit Vest
products.short: A button-front Fair Isle knit vest with embroidered houses, wreaths and flowers, in off white, navy or red.
products.description:
A round-neck knit vest with a full button placket and contrast ribbed trim at the neck, armholes and front edge. The Fair Isle bands run across the chest, and worked into them are embroidered details and small raised appliqués — potted flowers, wreaths, little houses.

It is a proper piece of knitwear rather than a printed jumper. The motifs are stitched, so they will still be there in five years, which is the difference between something you wear every December and something you wear once.

The fabric

A soft breathable knit, light enough to wear indoors without overheating — which is more than most festive knitwear manages. Three colourways: creamy off white with brown trim, deep navy with red, and a crimson red.

How it fits

Sized L and cut to layer, so there is room for a shirt or a long-sleeved tee underneath without pulling at the armholes. Buttoned it reads neater; open it reads as a waistcoat.

Looking after it

Cold hand wash or a wool cycle, and dry it flat rather than on a hanger - a knit this weight will stretch at the shoulders in a season if you hang it wet. Fold it to store. A cool iron under a cloth if the hem needs settling, never directly on the rib.

It is the most cute clothes for christmas thing in the shop and it survives well past December as cute clothes for winter — a piece of korean fashion winter knitwear with an actual sense of humour.

products.title: Belted Ribbed Knit A-Line Midi Dress
products.short: A black button-front knit midi with a buckled belt, gold buttons and white-trimmed pockets. Belt included. One size, to a US medium.
products.description:
A soft ribbed knit in black, buttoned all the way down the front, with a V-neck and long sleeves. The four pockets are trimmed in white and finished with gold-tone buttons — small contrast details on a dress that is otherwise one colour from top to hem.

A knit dress that does not cling is harder to find than it should be. This one smooths rather than grips, and holds its shape through a day of sitting down and standing up again.

The fabric

A fine ribbed knit with recovery in it. The belt comes with the dress: buckled, it puts a waist on an A-line that would otherwise fall straight; left off, the dress reads looser and more weekend. Both work, which is why the belt is not sewn in.
